digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler Jira adapter mapping seam
propositions: rebar's reconciler hardcodes project-agnostic mappings (status, type, priority, link relations) in multiple files, requiring core edits to support projects with workflow variance (e.g., Blocked status, Initiative type, missing Supersedes link)
A provider-neutral, config-driven mapping seam must layer built-in defaults with config-level default and per-project overrides (projects.<JIRA_KEY>), applying only to named keys

Rebar types with no target analogue must be collapsible (via rebar-type: label), skippable (type-granular exclusion), or fail-closed at config load; transitions must replay via core STATUS event log or drift with warnings
Non-representable parent relationships must drift and leave echo-safe breadcrumb comments naming the nearest represented ancestor's Jira key
The mapping core must remain provider-neutral (no Jira-specific literals), with all Jira specifics confined to the adapter, verified by structural isolation and capability descriptors
